blockers: OS-enforced filesystem and network isolation not verified

corpus.selection: 30 explicit anchors then category/region round robin with sha256(seed|id) ordering

document.null: empty text only in derived document; source bytes unchanged
document.normalization: none: no strip/case folding/Unicode normalization; UTF-8 LF
document.scope: new logical baseline, not a reproduction of old stored document format; description and artist assertions excluded

model.truncation: record truncated IDs; do not silently vary maxTokens

positive.unit: each language on locked holdout; mean recall=hits/number of relevant IDs; binary DCG=sum(rel/log2(rank+1)); macro average
positive.missingResults: zero contribution; do not omit failures

metrics.latency: measure warm/cold p50/p95 and RSS/disk without absolute performance pass claim; agree product SLA before production candidate

safety.newDatabase: absent; future empty path under separate execution workspace

reviewPolicy: User attested review completion without corrections; no independent external reviewer or per-item evidence asserted. v1 preserved; reviewed question content and relevance unchanged.

searchScope.queryTextConditions: ranking clues only; not proof of constraint compliance
